headline: Executive order sets the line of officials who would step in to run the Treasury Department if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lays out an order of succession for the Department of the Treasury. That means it lists which officials would act as Treasury Secretary, and in what order, if the Secretary and the officials above them are absent, have died, have resigned, or otherwise cannot do the job. No abstract was provided, so the specific positions named and their order cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Officials named in the line of succession could be called on to temporarily carry out the duties of the Treasury Secretary.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on August 12, 2016, though the exact effective date is not stated in the material provided.
